info.desc: ...Like Clockwork is the sixth studio album by American rock band Queens of the Stone Age, released on June 3, 2013 on Matador Records in the UK and on June 4 in the United States. Self-produced by the band, it is the first Queens of the Stone Age album to feature full contributions from bassist Michael Shuman and keyboardist and guitarist Dean Fertita, who both joined the band in 2007 to tour in support of their fifth studio album, Era Vulgaris, and recorded its bonus tracks. podcast.body: Released in 2013, this album was profoundly influenced by Josh Homme's near-death experience in 2010. His recovery from a botched knee operation, cardiac arrest, and a severe MRSA infection led to a shift in his perspective on life, which was reflected in the album's creative direction. "And the album Queens was finally able to release was very much influenced by what happened."

podcast.body: The band's previous album, released in 2013, was noted for its conceptual solidity and charisma. It featured a very dark, somber, and gloomy atmosphere, with enveloping guitars that were compared to David Bowie's dark style and the powerful sound of Judas Priest. "el Light Locker que el álbum de 2013 que salía muy oscuro, tenebre, lúbre con esas guitarras tan envolventes que a veces parecían en ese momento así tan oscuro de la capa de David Bowie pero a la vez tan judaspris."

podcast.body: This album, released in June 2013, was profoundly influenced by Josh Homme's near-death experience during surgery in late 2010 and his subsequent difficult recovery from MRSA, depression, and a two-year period where he could not hear music in his head. The recording process was challenging, and longtime drummer Joey Castillo was fired, with Dave Grohl stepping in to complete the drum sessions. "The album that resulted from this was Life Clockwork, which appeared in June 2013."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Years after his dismissal, Nick Oliveri provided background vocals for one song on the album, indicating a reconciliation and willingness to collaborate with Josh Homme. "If you look at the Queens album like Clockwork, you'll see that Nick provided background vocals for one song."
